description:
Counterfactual credit explanation: the minimal quantified actions an agent
can take to improve its SolvScore status. Free. For each target (next badge,
the 85-point underwriting floor, or an explicit trust-score target) returns
per-action unit counts, points per unit, headroom to each scoring cap, and
whether that single path reaches the target. Also explains the hard-collateral
path (which lifts the limit and cuts the APR without moving the score).
name: get_credit_improvement_path
